description: This file defines types, utility functions, and adapters related to channel status management, including runtime snapshots, status summaries, and issue collection for a plugin SDK in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: createDefaultChannelRuntimeState
methods.description: Creates a default runtime snapshot object for a given account ID, optionally extending with extra properties.

methods.name: buildBaseChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Normalizes a channel status snapshot, ensuring all lifecycle fields are explicitly set, with optional extra data.

methods.name: buildProbeChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Extends the base status summary with probe-related fields, preserving null defaults.

methods.name: buildWebhookChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Builds webhook channel summaries with a default mode of 'webhook'.

methods.name: buildBaseAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Constructs a standard account status payload from account info, runtime snapshot, and probe data.

methods.name: buildComputedAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a flattened account status snapshot from individual account fields, runtime, and probe.

methods.name: createComputedAccountStatusAdapter
methods.description: Creates a channel status adapter with customizable account snapshot resolution logic.

methods.name: createAsyncComputedAccountStatusAdapter
methods.description: Creates an async version of the computed account status adapter for I/O-bound snapshot resolution.

methods.name: buildRuntimeAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Normalizes runtime-only account state into the shared status snapshot format.

methods.name: buildTokenChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Builds token-based channel status summaries with optional mode reporting.

methods.name: createDependentCredentialStatusIssueCollector
methods.description: Creates a collector function for credential-related status issues based on source metadata.

methods.name: collectStatusIssuesFromLastError
methods.description: Converts runtime errors into standardized channel status issues.
